title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation
title_zh: 带观察校准自蒸馏的智能体强化学习
abstract_en: Large language model agents are commonly trained through reinforcement learning with sparse trajectory-level rewards, which offer limited guidance on how strongly individual tokens should be updated. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) addresses this by re-scoring generated tokens under a privileged replay view to obtain dense, token-level supervision. However, we identify a confounding issue: the resulting support may reflect both the privileged information contained in the replay view and score shifts induced by the replay scaffold, making it difficult to attribute the support specifically to that information. This issue is especially pronounced when future environment observations serve as privileged information, since replaying them requires reconstructing an extended scaffold that itself perturbs token scores. To resolve this confounding, we propose Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation (OCSD), which contrasts two structurally matched replay views, Full and Observation-Ablated, differing only in whether the actual future observation is present, to derive an observation residual that discounts score changes shared by the replay scaffold. OCSD then applies this residual to modulate token-level GRPO updates at high-uncertainty steps, while preserving the trajectory-level update direction. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA across three Qwen3 model scales show that OCSD consistently outperforms strong baselines. Diagnostic analyses further confirm that the calibrated residual aligns better with local environment feedback. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yiy1x/OCSD.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体通常使用稀疏的轨迹级奖励进行强化学习训练，但这种奖励难以精确指导单个 token 的更新强度。On-Policy Self-Distillation（OPSD）通过在带有特权信息的 replay view 中重新评分生成 token，提供稠密的 token 级监督。然而，论文指出 OPSD 存在混杂问题：token 分数变化既可能来自 replay view 中的特权信息，也可能来自 replay scaffold 本身引入的扰动，导致难以判断监督信号是否真正源于特权信息。当未来环境观察作为特权信息时，这一问题尤为明显，因为重放未来观察需要构造更长的 scaffold。为此，作者提出 Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation（OCSD），通过对比结构匹配的 Full replay view 与 Observation-Ablated replay view，仅保留真实未来观察是否存在这一差异，从而提取观察残差（observation residual），过滤 scaffold 共享扰动。OCSD 将该残差用于调制高不确定步骤的 token 级 GRPO 更新，同时保持轨迹级更新方向。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 上，跨三个 Qwen3 模型规模的实验表明，OCSD 稳定优于强基线；诊断分析也验证了校准残差与局部环境反馈更一致。
key_points_zh: 指出 OPSD 的关键混杂：token 级支持信号可能同时来自特权信息与 replay scaffold 扰动，尤其在引入未来环境观察时更严重。
提出 OCSD，通过 Full 与 Observation-Ablated 两个结构匹配的 replay view 做对比，提取更纯净的 observation residual。
OCSD 将 observation residual 用于调制高不确定步骤的 token 级 GRPO 更新，同时不改变原有轨迹级强化学习更新方向。
在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 三类智能体任务和三个 Qwen3 模型尺度上，OCSD 均稳定超过强基线。
诊断实验显示，校准后的残差比未校准分数更能对齐局部环境反馈，说明其监督信号更可靠。

llm_assessment.comment: Strong agentic RL work that improves token-level credit assignment from calibrated trajectory replay with future observations.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇较强的智能体强化学习论文，通过校准轨迹回放中的未来观测来改进 token 级信用分配。
